before.requirement: Process a local XPointer inclusion with XInclude streaming mode enabled and reject the expression with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED.
before.reason: The source has the restriction when XPointer support is enabled. The explicit harness route leaves streaming mode unset; the reader route and build configuration are unresolved.

after.requirement: Process a local XPointer inclusion with XInclude streaming mode enabled and reject the expression with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED.
after.reason: The same restriction remains. The explicit harness route still leaves streaming mode unset; the reader route and build configuration are unresolved.

claims.reason: The frozen restriction is the same on both sides, and the explicit old-harness context has the same setup constraint. Whether that constraint blocks the target as a whole depends on the unprovided reader path and feature defaults.
missing_information: Both versions of the xmlreader.c path from xmlReaderForMemory through xmlTextReaderRead to XInclude processing, including any streaming-mode setter call.
